automatedEvidence: browser-session.json records an accessibility tree of 1106 nodes with 57 named and 0 unnamed and 599 composed contrast pairs with none failing, worst 4.8:1 against a 4.5:1 requirement, on the build in this checkout. hosted-browser-session.json records the same 1106 nodes, the same 57 named, none unnamed, and the same 599 pairs, read from https://androlay.github.io/withheld/ on 2026-09-03 at 18:59:34Z — the live URL serves this build, so the local and hosted figures now agree line for line. Both runs also cover named controls, landmarks, focus order, keyboard traversal, and reduced-motion source checks.
whatThatIsNot: An accessibility tree is what a screen reader would be handed, and a contrast ratio is arithmetic on composed colours. Neither is a report of the page being read aloud, operated by a person who relies on it, or held in a hand.
reason: No independent screen-reader operator and no representative real device was available for a manual session. The build half of this blocker is gone — the page is live, so a reviewer needs a URL rather than a toolchain — and what remains is a person and a device.
requiredForRerun: The live URL: https://androlay.github.io/withheld/ — already met.
One person who operates a screen reader habitually, rather than a sighted operator switching one on for the occasion.
At least one real device that is not this Linux workstation: a physical phone at roughly 420px, and macOS or iOS if reachable.
No participant identity or personal data recorded.
rerunProtocol: Keyboard only, no pointer, at 1440px and at 420px: reach every control, complete one full pass from proposing marks to the human-only release, and record anything that cannot be reached or leaves focus stranded.
Repeat with a screen reader and record the announcements verbatim for landmarks, the live status region, a stale-revision conflict, staging, decline, and confirm.
Check focus restoration after the agent-contract disclosure opens and closes, after a conflict reload, after decline, after confirm, and after a browser refresh.
Confirm on a physical phone that the one-column fold behaves as the headless 420px screenshot shows, since that measurement was taken headless.
Record browser, OS, assistive technology and version, viewport, each observed issue, and each limitation. Quote the operator rather than summarising them.
A failure here is a work item for docs/PROGRESS.md, not a reason to lower a threshold in the harness.
notClaimed: No manual accessibility result is claimed. Automated accessibility evidence is not a substitute for a screen-reader or real-device session, and this package must not describe itself as screen-reader tested until this artifact is replaced.
